# Analyze a Position

Paste an XGID or GNUID to open the dedicated analyzer. XGID board preview is available in the Shiny app; worker-backed analysis appears when the server-side analysis service is configured.

## Supported Identifiers

- `XGID` for board state.
- `GNUID` for GNU-friendly board references.
- Optional fixture context strings when Marty is testing the page structure.

## Eventual Flow

1. Enter the identifier.
2. Show the local board preview.
3. Send the request to the analyzer route.
4. Stream quick results first.
5. Expand into the full report when the worker contract is live.

## Direct Links

The static site can link to the analyzer route directly, or embed an iframe example during private testing.

### Status Matrix

| Fixture state | What the page shows |
|---|---|
| queued | Waiting indicator |
| running | Progress bar |
| partial | Quick result visible |
| cached | Cached badge |
| complete | Full report shell |
| failed | Error block |
| cancelled | Cancel button state |
| rate-limited | Retry later message |
